title: Annex A.6 - AI system lifecycle
description: Working paper for Annex A.6: requirements, design, V&V, deployment, operation/monitoring, decommissioning.

sections.title: AI system objectives and requirements (A.6.2.2)
prompts: Verify documented objectives and acceptance criteria per AI system.
Confirm responsible-AI requirements are explicit (fairness, robustness, explainability).

sections.title: Documentation of AI system (A.6.2.3)
prompts: Confirm system documentation includes architecture, datasets, training method, evaluation results.
Verify model card / system card is maintained.

sections.title: Verification and validation (A.6.2.5)
prompts: Confirm pre-release V&V steps are performed and results retained.
Verify adversarial / robustness testing where applicable.
Sample V&V evidence for an in-scope model.

sections.title: Operation / monitoring (A.6.2.7 / A.6.2.8)
prompts: Verify alert thresholds and incident triage.

sections.title: Decommissioning
prompts: Confirm decommissioning policy: data deletion, archive, communication to users.

checklists.text: System documentation in place per system.
V&V evidence retained for current production version.

suggestedInterviewQuestions: Walk us through the V&V evidence for the current production model.
How is a deployment gate enforced — show us a recent failed gate.
Show us a production monitoring alert that resulted in action.
